labels.title: X-ray 1 Gy 4 h
labels.caption: X-ray, 1 Gy (lab dose), 4 h after exposure. Nucleus from a mouse the model never saw.
labels.mouse_note: Nucleus from a mouse the model never saw.

frame.units: native pixels of the BPS image / OSD-366 stack (pixel size not in the files)
frame.axes: x = column (right), y = row (down, image convention), z = slice index * z_px_per_slice
frame.canvas_to_native: r = (rc - g_pt + 0.5) * g_h / g_oh - 0.5 + g_r0, c = (cc - g_pl + 0.5) * g_w / g_ow - 0.5 + g_c0 (tt_common.Geom.canvas_to_native)
frame.winding: counter-clockwise seen from outside in (x, y, z); flip it if one axis is flipped

nucleus.how: 2D mask outline (filled, marching squares, Douglas-Peucker 0.5 px) extruded through the slices; the source has only 2D DAPI

foci_surface.how: marching cubes on x = log(1 + clip((I - b) / max(m - b, 1), 0, 60)) inside the main nucleus (b, m of tt_common.preprocess), zero-padded; quadric decimation

line2d.frame: canvas (row, col) of the 128 x 128 model input; native_* in native (row, col)

projection.note: 8-bit max projection of the crop box, linear 1st-99.8th percentile stretch; pixel (i, j) = native (origin_r + i, origin_c + j)

data_source: NASA BPS Microscopy benchmark (registry.opendata.aws/bps_microscopy, no restrictions on use) from NASA OSDR OSD-366 / LSDS-111, DOI 10.26030/v8w4-rg83 (Penninckx et al. 2019)
